rejected_boundaries: A hand muff or separate earmuffs cannot replace the connected hood-scarf form. No criminal identity, natural fur, religious identity, exact material, biological age, whole costume or extra garment is mandatory.

evidence.quote: The hooded scarf has a head-covering section joined to two hanging scarf ends.

roles.rationale: The positive parent directly owns the head-covering scarf accessory and its continuous two-ended construction rather than a general garment-body or identity claim.

facts.quote: The short sleeve gathers at its shoulder attachment and its narrower lower edge, enclosing a rounded upper volume.

decisions.meaning_summary: A short sleeve gathers at the shoulder and narrower lower edge, enclosing a rounded local upper volume.
rejected_boundaries: Different voluminous sleeve families and their end treatments are not simultaneous duties. No whole-outfit silhouette, hidden puff support, sleeve manufacturing history, exact dimensions, body shape, biological age or material is required.

evidence.quote: The short sleeve gathers at its shoulder attachment and its narrower lower edge, enclosing a rounded upper volume.

roles.rationale: The mandatory parent directly owns local sleeve volume bounded by its two gathered attachment edges, independently of a whole garment style or biological arm shape.

facts.quote: A sandal strap wraps around the same ankle and joins the sandal’s supporting straps.

decisions.meaning_summary: A sandal strap wraps around the same ankle and joins the supporting straps of that same sandal.
rejected_boundaries: Not every strap is an ankle strap and a flat heel is not a platform. No exact heel or toe shape, fastening mechanism, material chemistry, biological age, bare-foot condition or whole wardrobe style is mandatory.

evidence.quote: A sandal strap wraps around the same ankle and joins the sandal’s supporting straps.

roles.rationale: The mandatory parent directly owns the ankle-wrapping footwear route and its same-sandal connection rather than an unrelated body-binding cord.

rejected_boundaries: High waist and high leg are different properties and cheeky, Brazilian or thong naming does not impose fixed coverage ratios. No actual exposed hip, biological age, exact ratio, body elongation, material or entire styling is required.

evidence.quote: The garment's leg opening rises high at the outer hip.

facts.quote: Soft folds hang between the attachment edges of the same front neckline.

decisions.meaning_summary: Soft folds hang between the two attachment edges of the same front neckline.
rejected_boundaries: A deep neckline or shiny fabric alone cannot establish this attached fold construction. No particular fiber, chemical identity, exact depth, optical finish, biological age, hidden construction process or extra scarf is required.

evidence.quote: Soft folds hang between the attachment edges of the same front neckline.

roles.rationale: The mandatory parent directly owns local drape construction and both same-neckline attachment endpoints, not a material identity or optical response.

facts.quote: Two front panels overlap diagonally to form the same garment's V-shaped opening.

decisions.meaning_summary: Two panels of one garment overlap diagonally to form its V-shaped front opening.
rejected_boundaries: A V outline alone cannot certify an actual waist wrap fastening, and wearer left/right is distinct from frame left/right. Same-garment panel overlap does not mandate separate clothing layers, body exposure, biological age, material or an overall outfit style.

evidence.quote: Two front panels overlap diagonally to form the same garment's V-shaped opening.

roles.rationale: The positive parent directly owns the panel-to-panel overlap and resulting opening on one garment, without an unprovided waist-fastening mechanism or separate layer owner.
